decisions.reason: Turnaround management software has its own page, sits close to the core offer and is central to the announced data-driven airport direction, so visible commitment and sunk investment keep it firmly on the market.
The apron connectivity module underpins the integrated platform strategy, and slow uptake can still be blamed on long airport procurement cycles, so management persists.
Billing software is less central to airside operations and only mentioned on the website, but it builds on the established offer and has had little time to prove itself, so it is kept for now.
Apron resource management is close to the core and integral to the end-to-end operations suite, especially after Product D's removal, so strategic fit and sunk investment favour keeping it.
The controller safety alert service supports the firm's tower and safety positioning, and slow adoption among air navigation providers is still seen as temporary.
